title: [product question] Need helping finding similar product (Dr Dennis) in my price range.
text:
For the last week I have been sampling the Dr Dennis Gross "Hyaluronic Marine Oil-Free Moisture Cushion" moisturiser, and it has healed my skin. I have been having quite agressive breakouts on my forehead, and have month long scars.

This has helped heal my skin barrier, along with the cleanser I was trying out, Allies of Skin's "Molecular Silk Amino Hydrating Cleanser". Previously, I only cleansed with CeraVe foaming cleanser, which must have dried out my skin.

My ask is--- are there any similar moisturisers like Dr Dennis (as the 100 bucks is WAYYY out of my price range) that will help with acne breakouts? Or if the cleanser I have been using is doing the heavy lifting when clearing my skin up. PLEASE HELPP!!!! I'm sure lots of you guys reading this will struggle with breakouts, so any help will be greatly appreciated.

my skin:

combination, can get oily in t-zone, dry around cheeks+forehead. 

breakouts located: forehead or chin/lips.

title: [Routine help] New starter, got my cleanse right, now the moisturiser is off. Oily/sensitive skin playing games on me.
text:
I am 24F and I started this journey to try and combat oily skin, which made makeup impossible. I've never really had acne, sometimes I can get flaky skin on my forehead and cheeks (even despite the oil). Problem is, under the oil, my skin is tight and sensitive - I often have red pigmentation in my cheeks and feel burning sensations when applying some products. I can't seem to find a balance that controls oil without stripping my skin and leaving it on fire. 

Like I said, I am a new starter, following the advice to start with a cleanser, then find a moisturizer, then spf (I don't leave my flat much because of lockdown, so it can wait a bit). Here is my minimal routine, where I leave out the second cleanse in the mornings:

- Cleanse with Garnier micellar water. Love it.
- Cleanse with CeraVe Foaming Cleanser. Love it.
- Moisturize with Dr Dennis Gross Hyaluronic Marine Oil-Free Moisture Cushion. HATE it.

After moisturizing, my skin is on FIRE and I look like a tomato (redness fades over time but the tightness does not). I don't know if there is some sort of chemical conflict going on between the cleanser and the moisturizer, or if this moisturizer contains something I should be avoiding. Also, concerned that with the amount of oil in addition to the sensitivity, I might have damaged my moisture barrier, so perhaps this is completelt wrong. Any advice would be appreciated.
